high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from BusinessLine, a news website. The headline reads: "Replicating the IIT model: TN takes steps to establish University Research Parks in Coimbatore and Madurai." The article was published 6 hours ago. The main focus of the image is a photograph of the entrance to the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras. The entrance features a large sign with the institution's name prominently displayed in gold lettering on a dark brown background.
